text:
Alejandra: Heads up — since ~10:42 PDT we're seeing a spike of 502/504s from hosted-api in prod. Customer support pinged about bulk failures on generation endpoint. sample req-id: req_20260315_10:43:17_az1.

Ben (Acme): seeing ~30% of requests fail with 502s for our batch inference job. started after ~10:40, previously stable. no change on our side.

Alejandra: confirming internal alerts: envoy edge showing upstream reset and upstream connect timeout for pods running runtime v3.2.1. Not all requests — appears correlated to requests with seq_len > 1024 or large prompt sizes.

Marta (SRE): pulling envoy logs now. snippet: ```[2026-03-15T17:41:05.123Z] "POST /v1/generate" 502 UH/UPSTREAM_RESET/0 0 ms - upstream_reset: reset_reason=connection_failure, upstream_host=10.10.45.8:8080``` Also some 504s: ```upstream_read_timeout after 120000ms```

Raj (Runtime): runtime metrics show a flurry of worker restarts around 10:41-10:44 for the gen-pool in az1. OOM killer traces on a couple of hosts, one gc pause, and a crashloop for model-worker-17. attaching simplified logs: ```segfault at 0 ip ... code 0x0 in model_worker (libmmap)```

Alejandra: so chain looks like: load-balancer/NGINX -> Envoy edge -> runtime pool -> model worker crash => upstream reset -> envoy 502. Agree?

Marta (SRE): yeah. Also seeing proxy_conn_pool exhaustion: many TIME_WAIT sockets. tcp states skewed: high CLOSE_WAIT. could be keepalive tuning problem under burst.

IngressBot: auto-scale event triggered at 10:39: +2 nodes, but scale didn't catch up to concurrency surge.

Ben (Acme): what's the mitigation? customers are hitting retries and it's blocking pipelines.

Raj (Runtime): short-term mitigations: 1) enable automatic fallback to smaller quantized model variant for requests > 800 tokens 2) increase model-worker max memory temporarily 3) restart crashing worker to drain. Also throttle batch_max_size for that pool. I can push config change to runtime.

Marta (SRE): infra-level mitigations I'll do now: bump envoy upstream timeout from 120s to 180s only for the gen route, increase keepalive_idle and keepalive_interval on NGINX/edge, and increase connection pool size. Also mark the unhealthy host and re-balance.

Alejandra: can we set circuit-breaker to open for failing hosts to reduce 502 storm?

Marta (SRE): yes enabling host-level outlier detection and ejecting hosts with 5xx spike for 60s. done in canary.

Raj (Runtime): pushing runtime changes: reduced default batch from 32 -> 16 for gen-pool-az1, limited concurrency per worker, and applied fallback routing to gpt-q4-small for >800 tokens. rolling restart of pool starting now.

DeployBot: rolling restart job started: runtime-gen-pool-az1 (10 pods) — 2 pods at a time. ETA ~8m.

Alejandra: customer message drafted: "We're investigating 502/504 errors for hosted generate endpoints in US-west. Root cause appears to be model-worker crashes causing upstream resets; mitigations are in progress (restarts, routing fallbacks). We'll update in 15 minutes." Approve?

Ben (Acme): fine for now. any recommended client-side retries/backoff pattern while you fix?

Marta (SRE): recommend exponential backoff with jitter; max 3 retries; if repeated 502/504 for same req-id, surface to support with req-id. also reduce concurrency and shorten prompt if possible.

Raj (Runtime): additional repro steps for engineers: 1) hit /v1/generate with prompt ~2.5k tokens, temp=0.0, top_p=1; 2) use concurrency 48 from a single client to mimic burst; 3) include header `X-Request-ID: repro-502-1`; 4) we'll collect runtime logs: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime-gen -n prod --since=1h` and `journalctl --no-pager -u model-worker` on affected node.

Marta (SRE): request ids to correlate: req_20260315_10:43:17_az1 (failed), req_20260315_10:43:22_az1 (succeeded). pulled core dump from node 10.10.45.8 -> uploaded to /artifacts/cores/2026-03-15/node-10-10-45-8-core.tar.gz.

Alejandra: customer-facing status ok to post to status page after next update?

Marta (SRE): yes after we confirm error rates drop under 1% for 10m.

Raj (Runtime): after restarts and fallback, we're seeing error rate drop from 28% -> 3% in az1. still monitoring.

Alejandra: next actions: 1) complete runtime postmortem (Raj) 2) adjust envoy/nginx keepalive and pool defaults (Marta) 3) add a guard to route large prompts to the small-quantized model automatically when pool utilization > 70% (Product/Runtime follow-up) 4) notify affected customers with req-ids and ETA.

Ben (Acme): appreciated. please include whether this affects billing or data privacy.

Alejandra: no billing changes; no logs retained beyond normal retention. we'll notify if that changes.

IngressBot: alert cleared at 10:56 PDT — error rate down to 0.4% across prod.

Marta (SRE): follow-up to investigate root cause of worker segfault — suspected GPU OOM from a memory leak in model-lib when tokenization spikes. collecting pprof and core analysis.

Raj (Runtime): I'll open an RFC for safer fallback heuristics and add stricter health checks that gate envoy routing.

Alejandra: thanks everyone. documenting thread and moving to postmortems folder after root cause confirmed. if anything regresses, re-open thread. :thumbsup:
